arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_064" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T4 ON T3."XCL_099" = T4."XCL_093"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T4."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
  AND T3."XCL_096" < 300
  AND T1."XCL_002" LIKE 'E%'
